# Feature catalog

The rows below are the inventory's features, specifications, commands, editor panels, and version ladder. Status is `built`, `partial`, or `deferred`. A partial row works with the limit named in [Known issues and limits](known-issues.md). Module rows, crate rows, and per-flag rows stay in the inventory and are not listed here.

Content formats are listed in [Formats](../reference/formats.md). Agent methods are listed in [Agent methods](../reference/agent-methods.md).
